cycle._notes: Day and night length in ticks, cycles needed to win, dusk warning time, and night heating drain.

world._notes: 48 columns of 16-pixel tiles with ground surface at row 10.

energy._notes: Power for the base. Keep it above 0 or lights go out!

science._notes: Research points to unlock new buildings and complete Planet Stats.

boredom._notes: Crew mood (lower is better). Gyms and cafes keep crew happy.

revenue._notes: Funds to build, shield, clean, and repair your base.

event._notes: Fills faster when crew is bored. A full bar brings an event.

lose_conditions._notes: Seconds at zero energy or max boredom before base fails.

grace_and_recovery._notes: Peaceful seconds at start and quiet time after major events.

economy._notes: Refund percentage given back when removing a building.
